status: Independent directory owner, persistence and modernized controls verified within bounded native/browser coverage.

behavior.identity: Exact string identity, including case and Unicode. Successful source loads promote the containing directory. Loading a different file in the same directory promotes the same entry.
behavior.eviction: Keep the four most recent distinct directory strings, newest first.
behavior.restore: Restore the cached order without checking whether directories still exist. Restart starts without a loaded image.
behavior.clearFiles: clearMruFiles() clears file rows and icons while preserving directory history.
behavior.storage: The one current source-storage document requires directory, directories and files. Missing directories in an older local document is an explicit format error; no migration or fallback format.
behavior.browse: The Browse action beside a recent directory opens the image picker starting in that directory. Only a successful image load updates source history.
behavior.reveal: The Open Folder action asks the OS to open that directory. It does not load an image or mutate source history. Native successful Explorer interaction remains unverified.

ownership.operations: add(directory), snapshot(), clear(), SourceDirectories.fromSnapshot({capacity:4,directories}). Snapshots own their arrays; this owner does not resolve paths or read disk.
ownership.host: The existing source controller owns directory history alongside the separate file-history owner and cached icons. Its snapshot exposes directoryHistory. Storage keeps only the directory strings.

limits: Native picker interaction and cancellation remain unverified.
Successful native Explorer launch remains unverified.
Global Reset Everything is a separate behavior; its captured scope and remaining gaps are recorded in application-reset-contract.json.

presentation.rows: Directory names with full-path tooltips and accessible action names. Separate Browse and Open Folder buttons.
presentation.disclosure: The HTML disclosure starts collapsed, matching the native MostRecentDirectoriesWidget observations in window-reset-contract.json.
